messages:
vikram_procure: Vendor (Teton Logistics) just flagged a 10-day delay on a shipment of 48 H100s bound for the EU pool. They say customs inspection + thermal re-qualification. AWB CN12345EU. This drops EU steady-state by ~30% starting next week, so we need mitigation options. Do we accept partial RMA replacements, re-route capacity from US/APAC, or pay to expedite? cc @tina_logistics @maria_ops @jason_sc

Tina_logistics: ugh. 10 days is rough but plausible. can we ask vendor for split-air for critical subset? also need claim/insurance info. who owns the customs cost for re-qual? :thinking_face:

maria_ops: if EU pool goes -30% we'll see queue spikes on low-latency routes. immediate mitigation: 1) throttle noncritical batch work, 2) enable cross-region routing for critical traffic, 3) prioritize canary customers for Dedicated. I can push routing changes but need ETA on replacements.

jason_sc: vendor offering any price concessions? penalty? we should tie cost of expedite to vendor if thermal re-qual is their QC issue. also, how many are flagged DOA vs re-qual?

vikram_procure: vendor offered 50% freight credit + cover expedited air for up to 10 units. they claim only a small fraction need DOA-level RMA; most are stuck at re-qual. they proposed sending 12 replacements by air within 3 days if we sign expedited amendment.

ops_oncall: short-term ops ask: can we switch some EU traffic to our US Dedicated pool with acceptable latency impact? if yes, we can keep SLOs for top customers. otherwise we'll need to surface degradation.

maria_ops: yes we can reroute ~20% of critical traffic to US with 40-80ms extra p99 depending on region. need config change + routing policy update. I can schedule a 30-min window tonight to flip for critical routes.

Tina_logistics: on insurance — vendor says origin insurance covers transit but customs hold/re-qual related delays are excluded. we should escalate to their commercial lead. if we accept their 50% freight credit that's partial. recommend we open an insurance claim and push vendor for customs fee reimbursement.

jason_sc: sounds reasonable. also need to quantify cost of cross-region traffic for 30 days vs expedite amendment cost. can someone run a quick delta?

vikram_procure: quick math: extra egress + compute for cross-region ~ $18k/month for our expected volume; expedited amendment (air for 12 units) is vendor-covered up to 10 units, each additional air unit quote ~ $3.5k. net cost if we take vendor offer = ~ $7k out-of-pocket.

rma_bot: Automated: Created RMA ticket RMA-7842 for AWB CN12345EU. Initial status: Escalated -> vendor_review. Link: https://tickets.internal/rma/RMA-7842

Tina_logistics: tagged @teton_rep in vendor channel — asking for written confirmation on customs/re-qual root cause and commercial remediation. we need a formal amendment before they move units by air.

teton_rep: Hey team — thanks for quick responses. We can confirm re-qualification triggered after customs thermal inspection flagged inconsistent ambient logs. We're proposing split-air for 12 units; 10 covered per our goodwill offer, 2 at cost. We'll provide full failure logs and customs paperwork by EOD. Please confirm acceptance of amendment and shipping addresses.

ops_oncall: can we do a temporary capacity shift script: set route weight EU-critical=0.8, EU-batch=0.2 -> US-backfill 0.2? maria, ping when you're ready to roll.

maria_ops: will run change at 22:00 UTC and monitor latencies. setting up dashboard: EU pool health + cross-region p99. alert thresholds adjusted for 1h grace.

jason_sc: agreed on amendment but conditionally: vendor must absorb customs re-qual costs if thermal logs show margin breach on their side. otherwise we accept 50% freight credit + expedite. legal to draft amendment, ops to greenlight routing change.

vikram_procure: agreed. next steps: 1) Tina to get written cause + paperwork, 2) Legal to draft expedited amendment, 3) Maria to run routing shift tonight at 22:00 UTC, 4) Ops to monitor and report immediate pain points. Scheduled 30-min sync at 10:00 UTC tomorrow to confirm RMA movement and costs. :calendar:

Tina_logistics: started vendor escalation thread, requested customs paperwork. also asked vendor to attach thermal log snippets like: 
```
--- thermal_log excerpt ---
unit: H100-AX-00012
ambient_temp: 21.3C
max_temp: 85.2C
timestamp: 2026-03-20T10:02:30Z
status: flagged
```

vikram_procure: thanks. tagging finance for FYI on cost split. if vendor goes quiet, we'll trigger partial reallocation from APAC reserve (low-prep) as fallback.

teton_rep: paperwork sent. we've also queued 6 EU units for immediate QC pass — will confirm AWB updates by EOD.

ops_oncall: noted. i'll prepare an incident note template in #incidents in case we need to publicize degradation to customers. keep updates brief here. :thumbsup:

maria_ops: change pushed at 22:03 UTC. initial metrics: EU p50 stable, p99 +48ms for critical routes. monitoring.

vikram_procure: closing loop — vendor to confirm AWB updates; legal to circulate amendment draft. will update thread when RMA-7842 advances. thanks everyone.
